title: Joint ventures.
officialText:
Nothing contained in this section 28-410.8 shall be construed to prevent a master fire suppression
piping contractor business from entering into a joint venture of limited duration for a particular project with another master fire
suppression piping contractor business. The terms of a joint venture must be in writing, and documentation of the joint venture
must be submitted to the department for approval prior to the initiation of work under such venture.
